subject: website
name: Drums
summary: Drums, a marketplace for 50-gallon lots with UBNet listings. Its source is the served page, but it is Level 2: when it opens it loads the UBNet SDK (about 26 scripts) from ubnet.work with no integrity hash, so ubnet.work can change the code that runs. It also asks Coinbase for the ETH price.

connections.name: UBNet SDK scripts (ubnet.work)
connections.note: Third-party code loaded when the page opens, without an integrity hash.

connections.name: Coinbase price API (api.coinbase.com)
connections.note: ETH-USD spot price fetched when the page opens.
